result.title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 22 pages, including the complete technical appendix
result.summary: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 F2G-Pose，从单张 RGB-D 一次性前馈直接预测类别级物体位姿、度量尺寸与相机坐标系下的补全形状；方法把冻结基础模型的稠密视觉特征提升到点云，经 DGCNN 局部几何编码与 MoE Transformer 聚合物体级结构，并用形状补全的密集几何监督增强度量一致性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稠密基础特征提升到 3D 几何 + 形状补全作密集几何辅助监督」可能为 LVR 中如何在内部状态保留几何与任务必要视觉细节、以及辅助监督对贡献分配的影响提供可核查线索，但任务本身属位姿估计而非 VLM 推理。
